ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The attached figure is a circuit diagram. On the right there is a vertical resistor labeled 3 Ω, whose upper side is connected to the top common node and lower side is connected to the right/bottom common node; the arrow of current I is downward along this 3 Ω resistor. At the bottom there is a 2 V voltage source, with polarity labeled as left end “+” and right end “-”, and its right end is connected to the right/bottom common node. On the left there is a 10 V voltage source, with polarity labeled as upper end “+” and lower end “-”, whose upper end is connected to the top common node and lower end is connected to the left middle node. Reasoning: According to the method given in the problem, choose the right/bottom common node as the reference point and let its potential be 0 V. The bottom 2 V source has left positive and right negative, so the potential of the left middle node is +2 V. The left 10 V source has upper positive and lower negative, so the top common node is 10 V higher than the left middle node, therefore V_top = 2 V + 10 V = 12 V. The lower end of the right 3 Ω resistor is the reference point 0 V, and the upper end is 12 V, so the downward current I = (12 - 0) / 3 = 4 A.

raw_record.question_text: In the circuit shown in the figure, the current \(I =\) ________ A.

method.method_draft: First identify the outer nodes from the image: the requested current flows downward through the right-side 3 Ω resistor between the top common node and the right/bottom common node. Choose the right/bottom node as reference. From the bottom 2 V source polarity, assign the left-middle node to +2 V. From the left 10 V source polarity, assign the top common node to +12 V. Then apply Ohm's law to the 3 Ω branch: I downward = (V_top - V_bottom)/3 Ω = (12 - 0)/3 = 4 A.

推理：按题给方法，选择右侧/底部公共节点为参考点，令其电位为 0 V。底部 2 V 电源左正右负，因此左侧中间节点电位为 +2 V。左侧 10 V 电源上正下负，因此顶部公共节点比左侧中间节点高 10 V，所以 V_top = 2 V + 10 V = 12 V。右侧 3 Ω 电阻的下端为参考点 0 V，上端为 12 V，向下电流 I = (12 - 0) / 3 = 4 A。
